description: A Next.js + Supabase + Stripe app written the way the docs say: RLS with owner policies, getClaims() on every route, a signature-verified idempotent webhook under /api/billing/, and the service-role client in a server-only module. Every issue reported here is a false positive.
origin: Written for the corpus. It first reported two false blockers: the verified Stripe webhook as an unprotected route, and the `import 'server-only'` factory as a service-role bypass.
